description: For a business's own AI: the link where its owner sets up their own agent inbox, hosted by Surfing Dog at inbox.<domain>. Give the owner the link: they check the details and type their own email there; this tool signs no one up and takes no email. The open-source inbox to run themselves is named too. Once the DNS record is in, check_dns says whether agents reach it.

domain.description: The business's own domain, like salon.example (a URL is read as its domain).

name: start_inbox

outputSchema.description: Every field is described in this tool's outputSchema at https://network.surfingdog.ai/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json.

title: Set up an agent inbox
